refundAfterSoldOut._source: Compliance, compliance/website-legal-pages.md section 3, approved by Viveg 20 Nov 2026. {email} is replaced with the business email from company.json.
refundAfterSoldOut.en: Sorry, this item sold out before your payment reached us. We will refund the full amount you paid and start the refund within 7 working days. Card refunds usually take 5–10 working days to appear in your account after that; for FPX and e-wallets, the time depends on your bank or e-wallet. If you paid by DuitNow QR, we'll email you from {email} to ask for your bank details so we can refund you by bank transfer. We will never ask for your password, PIN or TAC/OTP.
refundAfterSoldOut.ms: Maaf, item ini telah habis dijual sebelum bayaran anda sampai kepada kami. Kami akan memulangkan jumlah penuh yang anda bayar dan memulakan bayaran balik dalam tempoh 7 hari bekerja. Bayaran balik kad biasanya mengambil masa 5–10 hari bekerja untuk dipaparkan dalam akaun anda selepas itu; bagi FPX dan e-dompet, tempohnya bergantung kepada bank atau e-dompet anda. Jika anda membayar melalui DuitNow QR, kami akan menghantar e-mel daripada {email} untuk meminta butiran bank anda supaya kami boleh membuat bayaran balik melalui pindahan bank. Kami tidak akan sekali-kali meminta kata laluan, PIN atau TAC/OTP anda.

bundle._source: Compliance, compliance/website-legal-pages.md section 6, and Design spec section 2 (22 Nov 2026). {sets}, {price}, {free}, {worth}, {missing}, {upgrade}, {bundle} are filled from products.json; no amount is typed. The conditions line must sit next to every 'free', at least half its size. No 'was' price and no 'Save RM' figure anywhere. 'switch' (all three sets already in the basket) is Design's draft from Viveg's own line, 22 Nov 2026 evening (design/decisions-2026-11-22-evening.md): offer only, nothing changes unless the buyer says yes. Compliance approved the offer, its conditions and the buttons 'Yes, switch to the Bundle' / 'No thanks' as written (compliance/admin-rulings-2026-11-24.md section 4).
bundle.conditions: With the {bundle} only. While stocks last.
bundle.upgrade: Add {missing} for {upgrade} and get the {bundle}, with a free {free} (worth {worth}).
bundle.switch: Switch to the {bundle} and get a free {free} (worth {worth})? Same price: {price}.
